notes.title: Ready to play a completely new genre in this game?
notes.content:
One Card One Shot: Mafia is not your typical card game
In this high-stakes mix of strategy and action, you’ll duel your opponents using tactical cards, then jump straight into adrenaline-filled sequences: car chases, intense shootouts, and tense moments where every move counts. Everything is unpredictable, every card could turn the tide. 


[previewyoutube="lUHhlrCWOBQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

Play smart, aim fast, and survive the chaos.
Step into a game that breaks all the rules. One Card One Shot: Mafia combines the mind games of card strategy with the adrenaline of FPS action and the unpredictability of party games. Outsmart your opponents at the table, then jump straight into car chases, shootouts, and explosive showdowns.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/246f72971f63b846eabc15ab13bb0ac064e09488.gif"]


Cards decide your fate. Bullets decide your survival
In One Card One Shot: Mafia, strategy meets raw action in a way you’ve never seen before. One moment you’re looking for your target on the table, the next you’re dodging bullets and racing through the city in high-speed chases.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/f096d97623574a0d5658cda08b124e84bb82f6cf.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/07f0c2b09aac36204eba0bc08a51e4ffa3b27b4d.gif"]



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332120/One_Card_One_Shot__Mafia/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Two Perspectives
notes.content:
In One Card, One Shot – Mafia, the action unfolds through two distinct lenses: intense 3D first-person shooter sequences and strategic top-down gameplay.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/51e70bf9cfa07d4a4da1a6eefda3db4dad9fecbb.gif"]


The perspective shifts naturally with the rhythm of the story and mission.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/e04a683bb25afc18afb95c04cfa70439af8d3d5a.gif"]


🔫 When it’s time to aim, you’re behind the sniper scope in full FPS mode:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/b7237b46a741547cf1bdc13330edc9733a543c1c.gif"]




🧠 When you’re planning your next move or playing your cards, the view switches to a stylish top-down angle:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/0c37843dffc125d79e8c72c5128281d551f0959d.gif"]


This unique blend of perspectives creates a dynamic, cinematic experience where every shot — and every decision — counts.


Check it out!

notes.title: Play now: One Card One Shot - Mafia demo!
notes.content:
THE ONE CARD ONE SHOT - MAFIA DEMO IS AVAILABLE NOW!
We're thrilled (and a bit nervous) to announce: the demo for One Card One Shot – Mafia is now available to play on Steam!
Get ready to dive into a world where strategy, action, and explosive cards collide in intense battles against the mafia.

Available from April 30 to May 4.

TRY THE DEMO AT GAMESCOM LATAM TOO!
Swinging by Gamescom Latam? Don’t miss this: the demo will also be playable at the Xbox and Panorama Brasil booths!
This is your chance to test the game before everyone else — and even score a launch key. Don’t sleep on it!

IN ONE CARD ONE SHOT – MAFIA, YOU WILL:


 Build a badass deck with cards that deal damage, protect your skin, or throw creative (sometimes totally chaotic) twists into the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/5f47cb113308c27fb2fa2b2e428408f08ab4a377.gif

 Face enemies that never let up. They attack, defend, and make you rethink your choices… kind of like adult life.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/f7ca1689b1927b4c0d6d5fda4729906bdb0b6b6e.gif

 Use secondary weapons at just the right moment to turn the tide when all seems lost.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/9f8562f855965c07878ad026b0e43ede00e4f407.gif

 Watch out — enemies literally fall from the sky. No metaphor here. One minute it’s calm, the next you’re staring at airborne thugs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/a9faca228ebfb71c1049856d9e6b48c50090f72d.gif

 Think you’ve got everything under control… until the fireworks start. Dynamite flies in from all directions and you scramble to defuse them — just don’t shoot one by accident. (We tried. Wouldn’t recommend it.)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/7f9174bb890a682aa0ca542d59819428160cfaab.gif

 Tackle fast-paced mechanics in both 3D and top-down shooter styles — because the heat comes from every direction here.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/53d5d62a1b9a8663778528ca032bd8ce4de862bf.gif


We truly appreciate your support — thank you!
This project is built with tons of passion (and probably too much caffeine), and having the community with us means everything.

Send us your feedback, your ideas, and even your most embarrassing defeats (we promise to laugh respectfully).
Join our Discord, follow us on social media, and wishlist the game on Steam so you don’t miss a thing!

Thanks so much — and good luck facing the mafia (you’re gonna need it). ♡

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332120/One_Card_One_Shot__Mafia/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Rbwh_aQBJg

notes.title: We are in the Latin American Games Showcase!!!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We have some incredible news: we have been selected for the Latin American Games Showcase!

Our beloved One Card One Shot - Mafia will be part of the best selection of Latin American games on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/51e70bf9cfa07d4a4da1a6eefda3db4dad9fecbb.gif

We would like to thank each one of you who has been following us, for helping to make the game even more fun, and for this great achievement.

Don't miss the chance to check out our game, available from June 8th to June 15th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/f0f3abd16aae94b639cf7b78b0124f1b56cd1bfc.gif
